scientific_interpretation.core_finding: When positive dictionary roots and negative pseudo-words are generated under identical template geometry (Exp G11 Factorial Matched-Control), positional classification power drops to random guessing (ROC-AUC 0.50), proving the positional shortcut is completely neutralized. Genuine character n-gram discrimination survives based exclusively on lexical transition probability distributions.
scientific_interpretation.residual_sequence_divergence: Exp G12 demonstrates that natural English dictionary roots exhibit lower trigram Shannon entropy than scrambled or pseudo-syllabic sequences, providing an explainable physical basis for n-gram separability.
scientific_interpretation.cluster_aware_variance: Cluster-aware bootstrap intervals are wider than candidate-level intervals, properly reflecting uncertainty across the population of root words rather than mere candidate permutation variance.
scientific_interpretation.research_gate_recommendation: PREDICT-PS has satisfied all statistical reconciliation and artifact synchronization gates. The baseline comparator is rigorously documented, bounded, and ready for Phase 5 Explainable Feature Fusion.
